source_title: How Vat Is Collected On Seller Fees
source_date_if_available: No date found. URL returned 403; content verified via search engine index.
snippet_primary: "Depending on your business status and location, Etsy may be required to collect VAT on seller fees accrued each month and remit it to the relevant tax authority. Etsy may also need to collect VAT on Etsy Payments processing fees for sellers located in eligible Etsy Payments countries where required."
